_note: Verbatim responses captured from the live ASFAI Learning MCP (asfai-learning 2.0.0, https://constitution.asfai.org/education/api/mcp) on 2026-10-10 via asfai_lesson action prepare_outline. These are the contract the host's intake gate binds to. Two facts to keep in view: the clarifying round issues NO clarificationReceipt, and ready_to_draft carries NO draftAuthorization.

questions.reason: An observable outcome anchors the outline.

response.next: Ask the unresolved questions, then call prepare_outline again with the answers and source-backed inferences.
response.storage: Caller-owned draft. Save a reviewed version through asfai_resource and verify persistence with asfai_storage; this call retains nothing.

storage_resource._note: asfai_capability get_skill name asfai-storage-local, for owner=educator: the save discipline the host's LocalArchive mirrors (atomic replace then REREAD then asfai_storage verify with expected/actual; say saved only when verified is true). Also note: these stores hold the learner profile and educator workspace ONLY - course files need a file-capable store.
